title: DongCheng 6 mm Electric Drill Machine with 13 Pcs Drill Bit Set, Screw Bit & Carbon Brush, Corded Power Drill Tool for Home, DIY, Wood, Metal & Wall Drilling
description: This 6 mm electric drill machine is designed to meet everyday drilling and fastening needs for home users and DIY enthusiasts. With a compact build and corded power operation, it delivers consistent performance for common drilling tasks without interruption. The drill machine comes with a useful accessory kit that includes a 13-piece drill bit set, one multi-purpose drill bit, and one screw bit. This combination allows you to work on different materials such as wood, metal, and light wall surfaces, making it a versatile tool for household repairs, furniture installation, and general maintenance work. An additional pair of carbon brushes is included to support routine maintenance and help extend the usability of the drill machine over time. The ergonomic handle design ensures a comfortable grip, offering better control and stability during operation. The corded electric design provides steady power supply, making it suitable for longer work sessions without the need to recharge. Whether you are drilling holes, tightening screws, or handling small repair projects, this 6 mm drill machine is a practical choice for home and workshop use. Designed for ease of use and reliability, this drill machine kit is suitable for both beginners and experienced users looking for a dependable drilling solution with essential accessories included.
